title: Rigidity of Newtonian Centered Co-Circular Central Configurations
summary: We prove that a Newtonian central configuration of finitely many positive masses on a circle whose center is the center of mass must be a regular polygon with equal masses. The proof selects an extremal mass–gap pair and lifts the circle to a periodic configuration on the line. A positive integral representation of the circular kernel converts the force equations into sharp weighted quadrature bounds.
